business_problem: Bermejo says to remain at the forefront of creating innovative fan experiences LALIGA wanted to be able to deliver extraordinary information to its audiences at lightning speed—and they knew it meant utilizing data. More than a decade ago, to empower its teams, LALIGA deployed Mediacoach, an advanced match data visualization platform developed by LALIGA Tech, the sports technology company from Globant and LALIGA. Mediacoach was designed to collect and analyze data during a match from fixed cameras placed around a stadium perimeter.

As one of the world’s largest sports leagues, LALIGA is a familiar name to soccer enthusiasts. To meet the ever-evolving demands of a content-driven entertainment enterprise, LALIGA puts fans first when developing new initiatives.
“Microsoft Azure perfectly complements our digital ecosystem to help deliver the best possible fan experiences for the world's best sports league.”

For LALIGA soccer fans, the essence of every soccer match exists in a many layered story, where club history, social media engagement, on-pitch performance, historic rivalries, and so much more coalesce into a unique and personal experience. Fans look to the Spanish soccer league to keep them apprised of not just the play-by-play during a match, but behind-the-scenes details on the teams and the players they love—and LALIGA is committed to delivering phenomenal fan experiences.
